title: Aromatic Silky Filipino Bread Toast
description: A resinous, silky toast glazed with honey, lemon, and spices, served on a banana leaf for a fragrant snack.
instructions: Arrange the banana leaf on a flat surface and lightly oil it with a little melted butter to prevent sticking.
Brush each pandesal slice with softened butter and sprinkle a light dusting of ground cinnamon and clove.
Place the buttered bread slices onto the preheated skillet over medium heat and toast until golden brown on both sides, about 2 minutes per side.
In a small bowl, whisk together honey, lemon juice, vanilla extract, and a splash of melted butter to create a fragrant glaze.
Brush the glaze generously over the toasted bread slices, allowing the syrup to seep into the crumbs.
Transfer the glazed toast onto the oiled banana leaf, arranging it in a single layer.
Sprinkle toasted sesame seeds and chopped mint over the toast, then dust lightly with powdered sugar.
Fold the edges of the banana leaf over the toast to create a loose pouch, and serve immediately while warm.
